traits.description: While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar's senses.

combat-strategy: This is a spy and harasser, not a frontline fighter: use Vampiric Connection to scout for the master and report through its senses, keeping well behind enemy lines with Stealth +7. In combat, snipe with Umbral Dagger from 20–60 ft., then use Deathless Agility to Dash or Disengage every turn so it never gets cornered — its 65 HP and AC 15 won't survive a sustained brawl. Prioritize lone stragglers and wounded targets, since any kill by Umbral Dagger leaves the victim stable but poisoned and paralyzed, effectively removing a body for an hour without a death the party can reverse quickly. If engaged in melee, land two daggers and kite immediately, and flee to the master or coffin when focused; losing the familiar costs the vampire its eyes and ears, so never let it die pointlessly.

name: Vampire Nightbringer

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vampire makes one Bite attack and one Shadow Strike attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

actions.name: Shadow Strike
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Cold damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the vampire takes the Hide action.

lair_actions.name: Children of the Night
lair_actions.description: The vampire exerts influence over the animals in its domain. From dusk until dawn, Medium or smaller Beasts have the Charmed condition while within 1 mile of the lair.

lair_actions.name: Looming Shadows
lair_actions.description: Shadows within 1 mile of the lair seem to move as if alive. Any creature (excluding the vampire and its allies) that finishes a Short Rest while within 1 mile of the lair must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from that rest.

lair_actions.name: Mists
lair_actions.description: The area within 1 mile of the lair is Lightly Obscured by a persistent, creeping fog. The vampire and any creatures of its choice are unaffected by the fog.

zone.advisory: 1-mile lair region modeled as a GM-positioned radius picker (no 1-mile token scale; gridless map). Lightly obscured has no obscurement/light-level consumer in this engine — GM-enforced. The vampire and creatures of its choice are unaffected — GM-enforced (no selective-immunity consumer). Persists until the vampire dies or moves its lair — GM-enforced (no initiative-20 lair seam / persistent-lair-state consumer).

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: The vampire takes 10 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

combat-strategy: Strike at night or in darkness: open with Shadow Stealth (Hide as a bonus action in dim light) and hover above or circle through shadow, attacking from coverage where its +7 Stealth keeps it unseen. Multiattack (Shadow Strike + Bite) hits for heavy cold and HP-max-draining necrotic damage that it heals on itself, so grind contested fights against single targets it can whittle and feed on. It lacks Legendary Resistances, so avoid mass disable magic — stay hidden, use +6 Stealth to break line of sight when spells fly, and exploit darkness where most party buffs don't reach. As a flying kiter, dive in, bite a straggler, and hover back out of melee reach; Sunlight Hypersensitivity means it must flee cover or ground at dawn, so force retreat before first light and never fight in open sun.

name: Vampire Spawn

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and uses Bite.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.
actions.save_effect: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount

bonus_actions.name: Deathless Agility
bonus_actions.description: The vampire takes the Dash or Disengage action.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.description: The vampire has these weaknesses: Forbiddance. The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant. Running Water. The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. Stake to the Heart. The vampire is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition. Sunlight. The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

combat-strategy: Hunt in packs and grapple to feed: open by dropping from ceilings (Spider Climb) or ambushing from hiding, and focus everything on one target at a time. The combo is Multiattack — two Claws to set up grapples (escape DC 13), then Bite for guaranteed necrotic drain and HP-max loss; two grapples mean helpless victims the spawn can dine on repeatedly. Use Deathless Agility to Disengage or Dash when needed so they don't lose momentum while repositioning between lair shadows. Keep them away from sunlight (20 radiant per turn plus disadvantage) and running water; if the fight goes badly or spawn numbers drop low, have them flee to darken the site, drag off corpses to raise as more spawn, and retreat to their coffin region rather than fight to the last body.

name: Vampire Umbral Lord

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vampire makes two attacks, using Grave Strike or Sickening Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Grave Strike
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sickening Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the vampire's next turn.

actions.name: Hunger of Hadar
actions.description: The vampire casts Hunger of Hadar (level 5 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).
actions.save_effect: Failure: 14 (4d6) Acid damage, and the target has the Blinded condition while inside the sphere of darkness (GM-enforced).

bonus_actions.name: Sanguine Drain
bonus_actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature the vampire can see within 30 feet that isn't a Construct or an Undead. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

legendary_actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 2
legendary_actions.description: Immediately after another creature's turn, the vampire can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The vampire regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendary_actions.name: Beguile
legendary_actions.description: The vampire casts Command, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
legendary_actions.save_effect: Failure: The target obeys the vampire's one-word command on its next turn (GM-enforced — obey-the-command is not a registered condition and no command-word-to-condition consumer exists; Death Knight Dread Authority advisory twin MA-0058). Success: The target is unaffected.

legendary_actions.name: Umbral Strike
legendary_actions.description: The vampire moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Grave Strike or Sickening Ray attack.
